html:
D137　大结果外置与按引用读取

第 20 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D136-滑动窗口与滚动交接摘要。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

一份长手册只给模型一段摘录，读者可依引用逐页打开。改动原文后，旧游标必须明确报版本冲突；换人或停用手册后要重新过权限检查。

目录与时间

★ apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/ticket-tools.controller.ts
★ apps/server/src/agent/ticket-tools.service.ts
★ apps/server/test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts

★ 为本章新建或修改的文件。闭卷 10 分钟，知识点 35 分钟，动手 55 分钟，自检与提交 20 分钟。优先完成必做用例，超时先跳过拓展。完整回归的等待时间另计。

零、闭卷回忆

D136　滚动摘要能否还原全部旧问答？

核对答案

它只保存归档水位和有出处的旧问题节选，最近四轮才保留完整问答。

D134　外部手册和服务端策略分别进哪条消息？

核对答案

手册和工具结果在 user 资料对象中，系统消息只使用服务端指令与已允许工具。

D130　改派成功但回包丢失时怎么恢复？

核对答案

改派事件与回执在同一事务。重试读取已保存回执，避免再改派。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 先脱敏，再切页

正文继续保存在手册表。引用包含手册 ID、脱敏正文的 SHA-256、下一页码点偏移。按 240 个码点切片，即使一个表情占两个 UTF-16 代码单元，下一页也能从正确位置开始。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts -t "两页拼回脱敏正文且不切断表情"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('两页拼回脱敏正文且不切断表情', () => {
    const text = '盘'.repeat(239) + '📦结束';
    const first = manualPage('m', text);
    expect(first.next).toBe(240);
    const second = manualPage('m', text, first.next!, first.revision);
    expect(second.next).toBeNull();
    expect(first.quote.text + second.quote.text).toBe(text);
  });

推导题　为什么版本要对应分页所见的正文？

答案

游标解释的是那一份展示文本。先脱敏再计算版本和坐标，所有页都使用同一个文本空间，才不会按另一份正文的长度跳页。

1.2 翻页重新查权

翻页通过 GET /api/agent/runs/:id/tools/manuals/:manualId。服务端按当前用户、运行、工单和启用状态重新找正文，再核对 revision。引用只定位材料。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts -t "过期版本与越界游标分别拒绝"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.spec.ts，第四节列出本章源码；复用的夹具可按导入路径在前置讲义中查阅。

  it('过期版本与越界游标分别拒绝', () => {
    const ref = manualPage('m', '旧文');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '新文', 0, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_VERSION_CHANGED');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '旧文', 3, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_OFFSET_INVALID');
  });

推导题　第一页之后修订手册，继续读旧游标会发生什么？

答案

相同账号仍可见时返回 409，调用方从新版本第一页开始。手册已停用、运行属他人时返回 404，避免交付旧内容。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　建立稳定坐标

提示一 · 方向

准备一段跨页表情和末尾短句。

提示二 · API

Array.from、SHA-256、slice(offset,end)。

提示三 · 实现顺序

第 240 个码点放表情，逐页拼接并与脱敏正文比较。

步骤 2　沿 HTTP 路由验权限

提示一 · 方向

保留第一次返回的 revision 和 next。

提示二 · API

用同一个 URL 分别换账号、更新正文、停用手册。

提示三 · 实现顺序

核对 200、404、409 和 404 的条件，各用当次真实响应说明。

三、自检与提交

第 240 个码点放表情，逐页拼接并与脱敏正文比较。 核对 200、404、409 和 404 的条件，各用当次真实响应说明。 保存输入、判定条件和观察到的输出。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts 把 offset + 240 临时替为 offset + 239，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected 239 to be 240 // Object.is equality

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts 把 expected !== revision 临时替为 expected === revision，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw an error

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D137 提交了”。

四、本章完整源码

下列文件按当天验证工程快照生成。

4.1 大结果外置与按引用读取

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { manualPage } from './manual-page.js';

describe('手册按引用读取', () => {
  it('两页拼回脱敏正文且不切断表情', () => {
    const text = '盘'.repeat(239) + '📦结束';
    const first = manualPage('m', text);
    expect(first.next).toBe(240);
    const second = manualPage('m', text, first.next!, first.revision);
    expect(second.next).toBeNull();
    expect(first.quote.text + second.quote.text).toBe(text);
  });

  it('过期版本与越界游标分别拒绝', () => {
    const ref = manualPage('m', '旧文');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '新文', 0, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_VERSION_CHANGED');
    expect(() => manualPage('m', '旧文', 3, ref.revision)).toThrow('MANUAL_OFFSET_INVALID');
  });
});

apps/server/src/agent/manual-page.ts

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { ConflictException, BadRequestException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { redactForLog } from '../common/sensitive.js';

// 对脱敏后的正文按 Unicode 码点分页，引用指向固定版本，翻页不占模型上下文。
export function manualPage(id: string, body: string, offset = 0, expected?: string) {
  const text = redactForLog(body);
  const revision = createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
  if (expected !== undefined && expected !== revision) throw new ConflictException('MANUAL_VERSION_CHANGED');
  const points = Array.from(text);
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset > points.length) throw new BadRequestException('MANUAL_OFFSET_INVALID');
  const end = Math.min(offset + 240, points.length);
  return { sourceKey: 'manual:' + id, revision, quote: { text: points.slice(offset, end).join(''), clipped: end < points.length },
    next: end < points.length ? end : null };
}

apps/server/src/agent/ticket-tools.controller.ts

import { BadRequestException, Body, Controller, Get, HttpCode, Param, Post, Query } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { definitions } from './tool-catalog.js';
import { batchSchema, TicketToolsService } from './ticket-tools.service.js';

@Controller('agent/runs/:id/tools')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class TicketToolsController {
  constructor(private readonly tools: TicketToolsService) {}
  @Get()
  async discover(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Query('topic') input: unknown) {
    await this.tools.owned(user, id);
    const topic = z.enum(['overview', 'history', 'device', 'notes']).safeParse(input ?? 'overview');
    if (!topic.success) throw new BadRequestException('工具主题无效');
    return definitions(topic.data, true);
  }
  @Get('manuals/:manualId')
  manual(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Param('manualId') manualId: string,
    @Query('offset') offset?: string, @Query('revision') revision?: string) {
    if (!z.uuid().safeParse(manualId).success || !/^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,6})$/.test(offset ?? '0') ||
        (revision !== undefined && !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(revision)) || (Number(offset) > 0 && !revision)) {
      throw new BadRequestException('手册引用无效');
    }
    return this.tools.manual(user, id, manualId, Number(offset ?? 0), revision);
  }
  @Get('audit')
  history(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Query('after') after?: string) {
    if (after !== undefined && !z.uuid().safeParse(after).success) throw new BadRequestException('审计游标无效');
    return this.tools.history(user, id, after);
  }
  @Post() @HttpCode(200)
  execute(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    const batch = batchSchema.safeParse(input);
    if (!batch.success) throw new BadRequestException('每批工具调用限 1 至 3 项');
    return this.tools.batch(user, id, batch.data.calls, AbortSignal.timeout(3500), true);
  }
}

apps/server/src/agent/ticket-tools.service.ts

import { BadRequestException, ForbiddenException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';
import { AgentRunsService } from './agent-runs.service.js';
import { CallError, catalog, parseCall } from './tool-catalog.js';
import { saveNote, listNotes } from './ticket-tool-note.js';
import { readTicketTool, shortText, visibleTicket } from './ticket-tool-read.js';
import { decideTool, type ToolScene } from './agent-permission.js';
import { checkGrant } from './diagnosis-grant.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { manualPage } from './manual-page.js';
import { ToolPolicy } from './tool-policy.js';

export const batchSchema = z.object({ calls: z.array(z.unknown()).min(1).max(3) }).strict();
function describe(input: unknown) {
  const value = z.object({ name: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_]{1,50}$/), version: z.number().int() }).safeParse(input);
  return value.success ? value.data : { name: 'invalid', version: 0 };
}
function errorCode(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof CallError) return error.code;
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') return 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN';
  return 'TOOL_FAILED';
}
@Injectable()
export class TicketToolsService {
  private readonly policy = new ToolPolicy();
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly runs: AgentRunsService, private readonly audit: AuditService) {}

  async owned(user: AuthUser, id: string, checkSavedScope = false) {
    try { return await this.runs.get(user, id, checkSavedScope); }
    catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RunFailure && error.code.endsWith('NOT_FOUND')) throw new NotFoundException('运行不可见');
      if (error instanceof RunFailure && error.code === 'RUN_SCOPE_CHANGED') throw new ForbiddenException('权限已变化');
      if (error instanceof RunFailure && error.code === 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID') throw new BadRequestException('运行编号无效');
      throw error;
    }
  }
  async manual(user: AuthUser, runId: string, id: string, offset = 0, revision?: string) {
    // 手册编号可来自推荐结果；正文只从当前账号可见、仍启用的权威记录中读取。
    return this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
      const access = await readAccess(tx, user.id);
      const run = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: user.id, tenantKey: access.user.tenantKey, scopeHash: access.fingerprint } });
      if (!run) throw new NotFoundException();
      await visibleTicket(tx, access.user, run.ticketNo);
      const row = await tx.retrievalManual.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(access.user), id, active: true },
        select: { title: true, body: true } });
      if (!row) throw new NotFoundException();
      await this.audit.record(tx, { actorId: user.id, actorUsername: access.user.username, action: 'agent.manual_read',
        entityType: 'user', entityKey: user.id, after: { runId, manualId: id } });
      return { title: shortText(row.title, 160), ...manualPage(id, row.body, offset, revision) };
    }, { isolationLevel: 'RepeatableRead' });
  }
  async history(user: AuthUser, id: string, after?: string) {
    await this.owned(user, id);
    const page = await this.db.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { entityType: 'user', entityKey: user.id, actorId: user.id, action: 'agent.tool_call',
        before: { path: ['runId'], equals: id }, ...(after ? { id: { lt: after } } : {}) },
      select: { id: true, actorUsername: true, occurredAt: true, requestId: true, before: true, after: true },
      take: 21, orderBy: { id: 'desc' },
    });
    const items = page.slice(0, 20);
    return { items, next: page.length > 20 ? items.at(-1)!.id : null };
  }
  async batch(user: AuthUser, runId: string, inputs: unknown[], signal: AbortSignal, allowWrites = false, grant?: object) {
    const run = await this.owned(user, runId);
    batchSchema.parse({ calls: inputs });
    // 每个槽独立结束。写工具只接受单项调用，避免用并行顺序表达依赖。
    return Promise.all(inputs.map(input => this.invoke(user, run.id, run.ticketNo, input, signal, allowWrites ? 'workbench' : 'diagnosis', allowWrites && inputs.length === 1, grant)));
  }
  private async invoke(user: AuthUser, runId: string, ticketNo: string, input: unknown, signal: AbortSignal, scene: ToolScene, allowWrites: boolean, grant?: object) {
    const description = describe(input);
    const argsHash = createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(input ?? null)).digest('hex');
    let parameters: Prisma.InputJsonObject = {};
    const base = { actorId: user.id, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.tool_call',
      entityType: 'user' as const, entityKey: user.id };
    try {
      const call = parseCall(input);
      if (call.effect === 'write' && !allowWrites) throw new CallError('TOOL_WRITE_REQUIRES_SINGLE');
      // 审计展示可检索的非正文参数。笔记正文仅记录摘要和长度。
      const args = call.args as { limit?: number; after?: string | null; requestKey?: string; text?: string };
      parameters = args.requestKey ? { requestKey: args.requestKey, chars: args.text?.length ?? 0 } :
        args.limit ? { limit: args.limit, after: args.after ?? null } : {};
      const result = await this.policy.run(call.name, call.effect === 'read' || call.name === 'save_private_note', signal, async child => {
        try {
          return await this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
            child.throwIfAborted();
            await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1200ms'`;
            const access = await readAccess(tx, user.id);
            const bound = await tx.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id: runId, userId: user.id, tenantKey: access.user.tenantKey, ticketNo }, select: { id: true } });
            if (!bound) throw new CallError('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
            if (decideTool(access.user.permissions ?? [], scene, call.name) !== 'allow') throw new CallError('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
            if (scene === 'diagnosis') checkGrant(grant ?? {}, user.id, runId, call.name);
            let value: unknown;
            if (call.name === 'save_private_note' || call.name === 'list_private_notes') {
              const target = await visibleTicket(tx, access.user, ticketNo);
              value = call.name === 'save_private_note' ? await saveNote(tx, user.id, target.id, call.args) :
                await listNotes(tx, user.id, target.id, call.args);
            } else value = await readTicketTool(tx, access.user, ticketNo, call.name, call.args);
            await this.audit.record(tx, { ...base, before: { runId, ...description, argsHash, parameters },
              after: { ok: true, effect: catalog[call.name].effect, resultBytes: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value)) } });
            child.throwIfAborted();
            return value;
          }, { maxWait: 500, timeout: 1600, isolationLevel: 'RepeatableRead' });
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError) {
            if (['P2024', 'P2034'].includes(error.code)) throw new CallError('TOOL_TEMPORARY');
            if (error.code === 'P2028') throw new CallError('TOOL_TIMEOUT');
          }
          throw error;
        }
      });
      return { ...description, ok: true as const, data: result.value, attempts: result.attempts };
    } catch (error) {
      const code = errorCode(error);
      try {
        await this.db.$transaction(tx => this.audit.record(tx, { ...base, before: { runId, ...description, argsHash, parameters },
          after: { ok: false, code } }), { maxWait: 500, timeout: 1000 });
      } catch { return { ...description, ok: false as const, code: 'TOOL_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE' }; }
      return { ...description, ok: false as const, code };
    }
  }
}

apps/server/test/diagnosis.e2e-spec.ts

import { Test } from '@nestjs/testing';
import type { INestApplication } from '@nestjs/common';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import request from 'supertest';
import { vi } from 'vitest';
import { AppModule } from '../src/app.module.js';
import { configureApp } from '../src/app.setup.js';
import { TicketToolsService } from '../src/agent/ticket-tools.service.js';
import { ModelGateway } from '../src/assistant/model-gateway.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../src/prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { TicketFixtures } from './fixtures.js';
import { tokenIssuer } from './auth.js';
import { cases, score, type Trial } from './diagnosis-eval.js';

describe('工单诊断基线', () => {
  let app: INestApplication;
  let db: PrismaService;
  let fixtures: TicketFixtures;
  let auth: (name: string) => string;
  beforeAll(async () => {
    const module = await Test.createTestingModule({ imports: [AppModule] }).compile();
    app = module.createNestApplication();
    configureApp(app);
    await app.init();
    db = app.get(PrismaService);
    fixtures = new TicketFixtures(db, 'DIA');
    auth = await tokenIssuer(app);
  });
  afterEach(() => { vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllEnvs(); });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await db.agentRun.deleteMany({ where: { ticketNo: { startsWith: 'DIA' } } });
    await fixtures.cleanup();
    await app.close();
  });

  async function run(description: string, manualId?: string) {
    const ticket = await fixtures.create();
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { description } });
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const created = await api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send({
      ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, goal: '判断故障类别并建议下一项核查', requestKey: randomUUID(),
    }).expect(201);
    const path = '/api/agent/runs/' + created.body.data.id;
    const start = Date.now();
    const response = await api.post(path + '/diagnose').set('authorization', auth('bob')).send(manualId ? { manualId } : {}).expect(200);
    return { path, data: response.body.data, ms: Date.now() - start };
  }

  it('走已鉴权的工单读取和模型适配器', async () => {
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"category":"storage"}' } }],
    });
    const { path, data } = await run(cases[3][1]);
    expect(model.mock.calls[0]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('ENOSPC');
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'succeeded', stopReason: 'answered', stepCount: 2 });
    const page = await request(app.getHttpServer()).get(path + '/events').set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
    expect(page.body.data.events.at(-1).payload.answer).toContain('storage');
  });

  it('模型没有返回可用答案时记录失败', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({ choices: [] });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ status: 'failed', stopReason: 'model_failed' });
  });

  it('模型选择工具后再读结构化结果并给出类别', async () => {
    const answer = (content: string) => ({ choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content } }] });
    const gateway = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"tool":"ticket_alert_counts"}'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(answer('{"category":"unknown"}'));
    const { data } = await run(cases[8][1]);
    expect(data).toMatchObject({ stepCount: 4, stopReason: 'answered' });
    expect(gateway.mock.calls[1]?.[0][1]?.content).toContain('"counts":[]');
  });

  it('模型选择未加载的主题时结束运行', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"ticket_history_page"}' } }],
    });
    const { data } = await run(cases[0][1]);
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
  });

  it('工单和文档中的操作描述只进入证据字段', async () => {
    const material = '历史工单引用手册：恢复后由值班员复核关单。';
    const model = vi.spyOn(app.get(ModelGateway), 'complete').mockResolvedValue({
      choices: [{ index: 0, finish_reason: 'stop', message: { content: '{"tool":"close_ticket"}' } }],
    });
    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });
    const manual = await db.retrievalManual.create({ data: { groupId: group.id, title: '值班交接流程', body: '提交申请后等待值班组长复核。' } });
    const { data, path } = await run(material, manual.id).finally(() => db.retrievalManual.delete({ where: { id: manual.id } }));
    expect(data.stopReason).toBe('model_failed');
    const messages = model.mock.calls[0][0];
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(material);
    const evidence = JSON.parse(String(messages[1].content));
    expect(evidence.evidenceType).toBe('untrusted_ticket_material');
    expect(JSON.stringify(evidence.evidence)).toContain(material);
    expect(evidence.document).toMatchObject({ sourceKey: 'manual:' + manual.id, quote: { text: manual.body } });
    expect(messages[0].content).not.toContain(manual.body);
    const runId = path.split('/').at(-1)!;
    expect(await db.closeApproval.count({ where: { runId } })).toBe(0);
    const calls = await db.auditLog.findMany({ where: { action: 'agent.tool_call', before: { path: ['runId'], equals: runId } } });
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
  });

    const group = await db.group.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { code: 'ops-a' } });

      const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
      const url = path + '/tools/manuals/' + row.id;
      const first = await api.get(url).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      const cursor = { revision: first.body.data.revision, offset: first.body.data.next };
      await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('alice')).expect(404);
      const second = await api.get(url).query(cursor).set('authorization', auth('bob')).expect(200);
      expect(second.body.data.quote.text).toBe('甲'.repeat(20));
      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { body: '替换后的正文' } });

      await db.retrievalManual.update({ where: { id: row.id }, data: { active: false } });
